questions.question: What happened to Ziklag while David was away?
options: A great fire spread through it during a fierce storm
Saul's army surrounded it and carried off the spoil
The Philistines seized it and made it their own stronghold
The Amalekites raided and burned it, taking the families captive
questions.answer: The Amalekites raided and burned it, taking the families captive

questions.question: What did David do after inquiring of the LORD?
options: Gave up the chase and quietly turned for home
Pursued and recovered everyone and everything
Fled away with the few men who remained loyal
Sat down and mourned long without taking action
questions.answer: Pursued and recovered everyone and everything
